content.body:
Click the Info button to see more information about your Brigade's location on the map. If you have a mission selected, this screen will also list the Origin and Target of the mission.
If you are in game, your Latitude and Longitude will be displayed, as well as a list of any waypoints for the mission.
And you can get the Latitude and Longitude of any position on the map by holding your mouse on that position.
content.title: General Map Information
